an5.143:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.143:1.2: athakho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya velāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an5.143:1.3: tena kho pana samayena pañcamattānaṃ licchavisatānaṃ sārandade cetiye sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi
an5.143:1.6: hatthiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ assaratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ maṇiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ itthīratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ gahapatiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.143:1.7: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasminti.
an5.143:2.1: athakho te licchavī magge purisaṃ pesesuṃ
an5.143:2.2: yadā tvaṃ ambho purisa passeyyāsi bhagavantaṃ āgacchantaṃ atha amhākaṃ āroceyyāsīti.
an5.143:2.3: addasā kho so puriso bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
an5.143:2.4: disvāna yena te licchavī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā te licchavī etadavoca
an5.143:2.5: ayaṃ so bhagavā āgacchati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho
an5.143:3.1: athakho te licchavī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho te licchavī bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
an5.143:4.1: sādhu bhante bhagavā yena sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an5.143:4.3: athakho bhagavā yena sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi nisajja kho bhagavā te licchavī etadavoca
an5.143:4.4: kāyanuttha licchavī etarahi kathāya sannisinnā kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatāti.
an5.143:4.5: idha bhante amhākaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi
an5.143:4.8: hatthiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ assaratanassa … maṇiratanassa … itthīratanassa … gahapatiratanassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.143:4.9: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasminti.
an5.143:5.1: kāmādhimuttānaṃ vata vo licchavī kāmaññeva ārabbha antarā kathā udapādi
an5.143:5.2: pañcannaṃ licchavī ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.143:5.4: tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.143:5.5: tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.143:5.6: tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa viññātā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.143:5.7: tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātā dhammānudhammapaṭipanno puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.143:5.9: imesaṃ kho licchavī pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasminti.
